description.narrative: CBIT 2 will deliver a range of socio-economic benefits at both the national and entity levels, contributing to more inclusive, efficient, and resilient governance and development. These benefits extend beyond climate reporting, creating positive spillovers across public administration, the private sector, and civil society. It will contribute to improved policy and decision-making by providing reliable, timely, and comprehensive climate data and information, therefore it will enhance evidence-based policy and investment decisions and support a shift towards low-carbon and climate-resilient projects. The project will enhance institutional efficiency and governance, which will lead to more efficient public administration, reducing duplication of efforts and increasing coherence across ministries and levels of government. Clearer mandates and responsibilities, enabling faster and more transparent implementation of climate and environmental policies. Additionally, the project’s capacity-building component will create new skills, competencies, and knowledge, which in turn will improve the employability of public servants and technical professionals, while also creating opportunities for new jobs in environmental consulting, data services, and regulatory compliance, especially as the EU carbon market and climate regulations expand. By improving the MRV and MRVA systems and aligning with the EU acquis and ETF requirements, Bosnia and Herzegovina will be better positioned to access international climate finance (e.g., Green Climate Fund, Adaptation Fund, and other donor programs). Gender-responsive benefits include the integration of gender considerations into climate data collection and reporting processes which will highlight gender-specific impacts of climate change and inform policies that address the needs of vulnerable groups while creating space for increased participation of women and underrepresented groups in environmental governance, data systems, and decision-making.
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

Strengthening Enhanced Transparency Framework in Bosnia and Herzegovina â€“ CBIT 2 objective is to enhance Bosnia and Herzegovinaâ€™s institutional and technical capacity to operationalize the Enhanced Transparency Framework (ETF) under Article 13 of the Paris Agreement through strengthening the country's Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) system and improving capacities for tracking and reporting on the progress of Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC), as well as mitigation and adaptation activities. The project will focus on addressing key gaps and needs by providing support for the finalization and formal adoption of the legal frameworks required for effective MRV, alongside enhancing the institutional and administrative capacities needed for successful implementation. Additionally, the project will develop and deliver a capacity-building programme for relevant institutions, ensuring sustainability and effective governance.
